name: Havengul Lich
oracle_text: {1}: You may cast target creature card in a graveyard this turn. When you cast it this turn, this creature gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: When you cast it this turn, this creature gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn.

needs.what: an op that, until end of turn, gives a permanent (here the source, objects self_only) every activated ability printed on a bound card or spell (here the creature spell cast via the Lich's permission, bound by a delayed spell_cast trigger), read from that card's printed abilities and kept after the spell resolves or leaves the stack
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_ability hands over only a fixed entry of this card's own grantable_abilities by index, not abilities read off another card; become_copy copies all characteristics and name rather than adding just activated abilities; the static grant_exiled_abilities walks only cards the source exiled and is a static, not a one-shot until-end-of-turn effect on a cast spell. The first sentence (grant_playable with playable_this_turn and playable_cast_only on a targeted creature card in any graveyard) and the delayed spell_cast trigger look expressible, but the card cannot be written partially.
